newsitem.title: JAPAN: North Korea slams visit by Seoul's Kim to Japan.
newsitem.headline: North Korea slams visit by Seoul's Kim to Japan.

text.p: North Korea on Thursday slammed South Korean President Kim Young-sam's visit to Japan this weekend, questioning why Kim would visit Japan when his country was in a "serious political and economic crisis".

"Why the traitor Kim Young-sam is going to visit Japan in the beginning of the year and at this time when the political situation of South Korea is totally paralysed draws international attention," North Korea's official Korea Central News Agency (KCNA) said in a report monitored in Tokyo.
South Korea has been rocked by industrial strife since a controversial labour law was passed more than three weeks ago.
Kim will spend two days from Saturday in the scenic hot-spring resort of Beppu in southern Japan to meet Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and other officials.
"He is in the most serious political and economic crisis in his term of office," KCNA quoted the spokesman for the Korean Society for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries as saying.

"It is obvious that during his overseas trip, Kim Young-sam, forsaken at home and abroad, will beg Japan to remain in the 'cooperation system' against the DPRK (North Korea) and to refrain from humanitarian assistance to the DPRK," KCNA said.
